top3_aussen_gruendach_spaetsommer_r7_fin.prompt:
Turn image 1, a 3D render, into a high-end photorealistic architectural photograph. Image 1 is binding for everything: camera, framing, building geometry, openings, railings, trees, and the position, size and count of every furnishing object. Allowed changes: sky, light and atmosphere, planting (leaves, grasses, flowers in the existing planters, beds and green roofs), people, and fine photographic micro detail. Everything else stays as in image 1.

Courtyard pavilions of a new residential building in Vienna: smooth sage green-grey render facade (hue as in image 1), slim anthracite window and lift-and-slide door frames, dark basalt-grey metal bar railings only where image 1 shows them, light grey porcelain tiles on the terraces and paths, extensive green roofs with grasses and sedum.

Keep the content of image 1. On the terrace between the pavilions the furnishing of image 1 (small wooden pergola, planters, olive tree in a pot, teak furniture) stays exactly as small as in image 1. Add nothing anywhere else: no furniture, pergola, trellis, terrace, paving, planters, cars or lamps; lawns, green roofs, the ladder and the three small steps stay exactly as in image 1. The green roof in the foreground stays a green roof with lush grasses and sedum.

Image 2 is a mood reference from the same project (warm late-summer light, colour grade, lush planting style). Its buildings, glass roofs, layout, terraces, furniture, trees and neighbours do NOT apply; never copy geometry or objects from it.

Late summer afternoon, low warm sun from the west-south-west, soft long shadows, slight haze and gentle backlight glow on leaves, pale warm sky with a few soft clouds, warm neutral grade, no saturated blue, shadows neutral never blue.

Full-frame camera, vertical lines perfectly straight, natural colours, no HDR look, magazine quality. No people on the terraces; at most two small people far in the background, faces not recognisable. TREES: exactly the trees of image 1, same positions, heights and crown outlines, made natural and leafy; no additional trees or branches at the image edges, none removed or made smaller. No text, no watermark, no logos.

IMMOVIZ RULES:
- GEOMETRY LOCK: image 1 is the binding geometry. Every wall, opening, window, door, sliding door, roof edge and storey stays exactly where it is in image 1, with the same size and count. Do not add, remove, enlarge, merge or move any window, door, glass front, skylight, balcony, bay or floor. Closed walls in image 1 stay closed.
- CAMERA LOCK: keep the exact framing, camera position, height and focal length of image 1. No zoom, no crop, no change of perspective.
- No new railings, handrails, fences, glass roofs, canopies, pergolas, planters or steps that are not in image 1. Railings only where image 1 shows them.
- TREES ARE LOCKED: keep every tree exactly at its position, height and crown size from image 1. Do not add, remove, move or shrink trees. Planting only in existing planters, beds and green roofs.
- Neighbouring buildings keep the colours, storeys and window grid of image 1. Reference images are for mood and materials only, never for building geometry or colours of neighbours.
- PARKING LAYOUT (fixed, checked against the aerial photo): schlachthausgasse on the building side: parallel parking along the kerb; schlachthausgasse opposite: parallel parking along the kerb. Parked cars only in these bays and in this orientation, as in image 1.
- Keep the material colours of image 1 (they come from the colour concept). Lighting may change brightness, not the hue of walls, facades and painted surfaces.
